explanation: The equation z^2=-12y describes a parabola in the yz-plane. Since x is absent and unrestricted, the parabola extends along the x-axis, forming a parabolic cylinder whose axis is the x-axis.

answers.correct_value: A parabolic cylinder whose axis is the $x$-axis
answers.wrong_value: A parabolic cylinder whose axis is the $y$-axis
